name: Villamanta (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villamanta (a bridge on red, fleurs-de-lis and a dog).
history: The arms of Villamanta were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 12 March 1988; the flag is described in the Regulation of Organisation and Functioning of the town council as consisting of two bands, one blue and one yellow, each occupying half of the cloth.

features.role: Villamanta arms — bridge on red, fleurs-de-lis and dog
